messages.subject: Add multiple labels specifications in scale_x_continuous
messages.subject_clean: Add multiple labels specifications in scale_x_continuous
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I wanted to add multiple label specifications in my plot. In my case i wanted to add the absolute and and suppress the scientific format.

I tried to add it twice, however, it will only use the last mentioned label specifications. Is there a way to combine the two. Attached is my code below.
ggplot(mtcars,aes(x=disp, y= wt) )+
    geom_point()+
    scale_x_continuous(labels =abs, n.breaks = 10) +
  # scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE))

Thanks in advance,
Chido

messages.subject: Geom_Segment: Size function not changing line thickness on plot
messages.subject_clean: Geom_Segment: Size function not changing line thickness on plot
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I am having issues with the "size" function of geom_segment when designing my violin plots. I think the default lines are too thin. I tried three values as a test run:

size = 1.0
size = 0.3
size = 0.7

Then line remains the same thickness no matter what. I am not sure how I am using the code incorrectly.  I tried looking here for some guidance
https://mpn.metworx.com/packages/ggplot2/3.3.0/reference/geom_segment.html

but  it did not really help.

Here is some of my code:

YLD1<- {YLD + theme(text = element_text(size = 14)) + + ylab("Yield (kg/ha)")+ + geom_segment(aes(x = 1 , y = 1921.66, xend = 1.3, yend= 1921.66,colour = "Overley", size =0.01))  + geom_segment(aes(x = 1 , y = 1921.66, xend = 0.7, yend= 1921.66, colour = "Overley", size =0.01)) ....

So in this plot no matter how I changed the size the thickness was always the same.

Can you someone give some guidance?

Thanks
Rose
